column1: # tests/expected/crash_sweep.tsv — ONE PLANTED CRASH PER CALL OF vs_ctl_show_err (#310, 14z-218). Read by
# tests/test_crash_sweep.sh (and tests/audit_crash_sweep_emu.sh for the emulator and linux rows); the static half is
# `python3 tools/crash_sweep.py check` (every caller's every call site covered by a row, or exempted below with a reason).
# COLUMNS: gate, tier (static|emulator|linux), mode (a declared control, or PLAIN), kind (py: a python3 call through
#   PATH; sh: a sh/bash script call through PATH — tracked scripts are never planted nor counted; pyx: any Python process,
#   through sitecustomize), ere (matched against the call's first argument line), nth (the planted call among the matches),
#   site (tools/crash_sweep.py's key `<first argument>#<k>`, or `-` for a regression row), fx (the gate as it stands must
#   read this: DIED|UNJUDGED for a mode, FAIL for PLAIN), kb (the same plant with vs_ctl_show_err neutered: HONOURED / PASS
#   — the row reaches THAT call and the call is what surfaces the crash; `-` when the crash surfaces without the helper
# WHERE THE ROWS CAME FROM: the 14z-216 discovery (build/agent216/t310/, local) and 14z-218's per-call passes on ERIS,
#   PILOT and the Mac (build/agent218/t310/, local; triage3.py / select2.py): each row is the cheapest PROVEN run reaching
#   its site, else the cheapest SURFACED one. Re-freeze: re-run the sweep (the rig there), then select2.py.
# EXEMPT: test_ctl_show_err — its two calls are inside the stub gates it writes and runs; it IS the helper's proof (cases a-e, four controls), on stubs

# EXEMPT-SITE: test_attribute_patch_delta "$W/ctl.txt"#1 — an expected-exception call behind `grep -q FileNotFoundError`: a planted crash (RuntimeError) never reaches it; the branch is test_ctl_show_err's case (d)

# EXEMPT-SITE: test_win_stdout_utf8 "$W/apply_cp932.txt"#3 — an expected-exception call (UnicodeEncodeError) behind the twin's exit/count test; a planted crash never reaches it; the branch is test_ctl_show_err's case (d)
# EXEMPT-SITE: test_win_stdout_utf8 "$W/out_unguarded.log"#1 — an expected-exception call behind `grep -q AttributeError`; a planted crash never reaches it; the branch is test_ctl_show_err's case (d)

# EXEMPT-SITE: test_agent_hooks "$W/replay.txt"#1 — under `set -e` a crash of the replay harness ends the gate at the call itself (FAIL, its traceback in the log: measured 14z-218, the PLAIN `- tools/agent/hooks/pre_bash.py` plant read FAIL in 1 s with the planted traceback), so this call fires only on a decision mismatch

# EXEMPT-SITE: test_agent_hooks "$W/ctl_$c.txt"#1 — the same shape for the four replay twins: a crash of their harness ends the gate under `set -e` (each twin's `- <copy>/pre_bash.py` plant read FAIL with the traceback); a crashed HOOK is the `ctl_crashed` call's row

# EXEMPT-SITE: test_release_reuse "$T/shadow_tb.log"#1 — fires only on a traceback the identity tool's SHADOW writes through its own excepthook (TB-HOOK); a planted crash replaces the process before the shadow installs it, so no kind here reaches it — a known gap, named on #310
